posts.title: The Unhappy Web Person
posts.description: The smallweb draws a certain kind of unhappy cynic. Chronically online, this kind of person sees evil everywhere. Probably depressed, fatigued with the state of the world, and able to find something wrong, immoral or reprehensible in most things. This is the kind of person you are likely to find on Reddit. Here's an example. I'm on the 32-Bit Café forum, where someone started a thread about Cauena

posts.title: Dear R
posts.description: I read once that a new life comes always at the cost of your old one. I’ve got one foot firmly planted in our future. The prospect of you and me seems recklessly exciting with a million and one possibilities. Will you join me? Presently yours, B New York, 17 October 2023

posts.title: Soup. Therefore, Love.
posts.description: Before work I made my way over to one of the restaurants near my place. I’d also gone the previous day, so the cook recognized me and smiled when I asked for the same thing again—a spicy hominy and pork soup with lettuce and a tostada. Today it was extra spicy.
